# 1. Libraries

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(homologene)   # mmu <-> hsa ortholog mapping (NCBI HomoloGene build 68)
library(ggrepel)
```

# 2. Parameters

```{r params}
dir_ref  <- "F:/wd/cohort7_miRNAs/ref"
dir_02   <- "F:/wd/cohort7_miRNAs/external validation/output/02_GSE155096_homolog"
dir_out  <- "F:/wd/cohort7_miRNAs/external validation/output/02.1_target_Jaccard"
dir.create(dir_out, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ts_dir_hsa <- file.path(dir_ref, "TargetScan_v8.0", "human")
ts_dir_mmu <- file.path(dir_ref, "TargetScan_v8.0", "mouse")
mirdb_path <- file.path(dir_ref, "miRDB_v6.0_prediction_result.txt")

cat("Output dir:", dir_out, "\n")
```

# 3. Load homologous miRNA pairs

Reuse the pairs identified in script 02 (mouse maSigPro miRNAs matched to GSE155096
human homologs). Each row is one unique (mmu_miRNA, hsa_miRNA) pair.

```{r load-pairs}
pairs_raw <- read.csv(file.path(dir_02, "homolog_pairs_matched_in_GSE155096.csv"),
                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

pairs <- pairs_raw %>%
  distinct(mmu_miRNA, hsa_miRNA, miRNA_cluster, miR_family, conservation)

cat("Unique mmu miRNAs:", n_distinct(pairs$mmu_miRNA), "\n")
cat("Unique hsa miRNAs:", n_distinct(pairs$hsa_miRNA), "\n")
cat("Total pairs      :", nrow(pairs), "\n")
print(pairs)
```

# 4. TargetScan: miRNA name → miR Family lookup

TargetScan predictions are stored by *miR Family*, not individual miRNA names.
Build a lookup table from the miR_Family_Info files.

```{r ts-family-lookup}
read_family_info <- function(path) {
  read.delim(path, header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      mirna_name = `MiRBase ID`,
      mir_family = `miR family`
    )
}

family_hsa <- read_family_info(file.path(ts_dir_hsa, "miR_Family_Info_hsa.txt"))
family_mmu <- read_family_info(file.path(ts_dir_mmu, "miR_Family_Info_mmu.txt"))

cat("hsa family entries:", nrow(family_hsa), "\n")
cat("mmu family entries:", nrow(family_mmu), "\n")
```

# 5. TargetScan: load predicted target genes

Load all predicted targets (no score filter) and keep only Gene Symbol + miR Family.

```{r ts-targets}
read_ts_targets <- function(path) {
  read.delim(path, header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      mir_family  = `miR Family`,
      gene_symbol = `Gene Symbol`
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(gene_symbol), gene_symbol != "") %>%
    distinct()
}

ts_hsa <- read_ts_targets(file.path(ts_dir_hsa, "Predicted_Targets_Info_hsa.txt"))
ts_mmu <- read_ts_targets(file.path(ts_dir_mmu, "Predicted_Targets_Info_mmu.txt"))

cat("TargetScan hsa records:", nrow(ts_hsa),
    " | unique families:", n_distinct(ts_hsa$mir_family), "\n")
cat("TargetScan mmu records:", nrow(ts_mmu),
    " | unique families:", n_distinct(ts_mmu$mir_family), "\n")
```

# 6. miRDB: load predictions and map RefSeq → gene symbol

miRDB v6.0 stores targets as RefSeq NM_ accessions (version-stripped).
Map to gene symbols using org.Hs.eg.db / org.Mm.eg.db.

```{r mirdb-load}
mirdb_raw <- read.delim(mirdb_path, header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                        col.names = c("mirna_name", "refseq", "score")) %>%
  mutate(refseq_base = sub("\\.\\d+$", "", refseq))  # strip version suffix

mirdb_hsa_raw <- mirdb_raw %>%
  filter(startsWith(mirna_name, "hsa-")) %>%
  distinct(mirna_name, refseq_base)

mirdb_mmu_raw <- mirdb_raw %>%
  filter(startsWith(mirna_name, "mmu-")) %>%
  distinct(mirna_name, refseq_base)

cat("miRDB hsa entries:", nrow(mirdb_hsa_raw), "\n")
cat("miRDB mmu entries:", nrow(mirdb_mmu_raw), "\n")
```

```{r mirdb-map-hsa}
hsa_refseqs <- unique(mirdb_hsa_raw$refseq_base)
hsa_sym_map <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys    = hsa_refseqs,
  keytype = "REFSEQ",
  column  = "SYMBOL",
  multiVals = "first"
)
hsa_sym_df <- tibble(
  refseq_base = names(hsa_sym_map),
  gene_symbol = unname(hsa_sym_map)
) %>% filter(!is.na(gene_symbol))

mirdb_hsa <- mirdb_hsa_raw %>%
  left_join(hsa_sym_df, by = "refseq_base") %>%
  filter(!is.na(gene_symbol)) %>%
  distinct(mirna_name, gene_symbol)

cat("miRDB hsa: mapped", nrow(mirdb_hsa), "mirna–gene pairs",
    "(", round(nrow(mirdb_hsa) / nrow(mirdb_hsa_raw) * 100, 1), "% of entries)\n")
```

```{r mirdb-map-mmu}
mmu_refseqs <- unique(mirdb_mmu_raw$refseq_base)
mmu_sym_map <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(
  org.Mm.eg.db,
  keys    = mmu_refseqs,
  keytype = "REFSEQ",
  column  = "SYMBOL",
  multiVals = "first"
)
mmu_sym_df <- tibble(
  refseq_base = names(mmu_sym_map),
  gene_symbol = unname(mmu_sym_map)
) %>% filter(!is.na(gene_symbol))

mirdb_mmu <- mirdb_mmu_raw %>%
  left_join(mmu_sym_df, by = "refseq_base") %>%
  filter(!is.na(gene_symbol)) %>%
  distinct(mirna_name, gene_symbol)

cat("miRDB mmu: mapped", nrow(mirdb_mmu), "mirna–gene pairs",
    "(", round(nrow(mirdb_mmu) / nrow(mirdb_mmu_raw) * 100, 1), "% of entries)\n")
```

# 7. Build mmu → hsa ortholog map

Convert all mouse gene symbols collected from TargetScan and miRDB to their
human ortholog symbols using NCBI HomoloGene (via the `homologene` package).
This correctly handles pairs with different symbols (e.g., Trp53 → TP53).
Mouse genes without a recorded human ortholog are excluded from the mmu target
set, so Jaccard is computed entirely in hsa gene symbol space.

```{r ortholog-map}
# Collect unique mouse gene symbols in their ORIGINAL case.
# homologene() does case-sensitive matching against MGI symbols (e.g. "Gapdh"),
# so toupper() must NOT be applied before the lookup.
all_mmu_symbols <- unique(c(
  ts_mmu$gene_symbol,
  mirdb_mmu$gene_symbol
))
cat("Unique mmu gene symbols to map:", length(all_mmu_symbols), "\n")

# homologene() returns a data.frame; column names are the taxon IDs as strings
# inTax = 10090 (Mus musculus), outTax = 9606 (Homo sapiens)
ortho_raw <- homologene(all_mmu_symbols, inTax = 10090, outTax = 9606)

ortho_map <- ortho_raw %>%
  dplyr::rename(mmu_symbol = `10090`, hsa_symbol = `9606`) %>%
  filter(mmu_symbol != "", hsa_symbol != "") %>%
  distinct(mmu_symbol, hsa_symbol)

cat("mmu symbols mapped to hsa orthologs:", n_distinct(ortho_map$mmu_symbol),
    "/", length(all_mmu_symbols), "\n")
cat("Coverage:", round(n_distinct(ortho_map$mmu_symbol) /
                         length(all_mmu_symbols) * 100, 1), "%\n")

# Build lookup with toupper() keys so get_targets_mmu() can query case-insensitively
ortho_vec <- setNames(ortho_map$hsa_symbol, toupper(ortho_map$mmu_symbol))
```

# 8. Build target gene sets per individual miRNA (hsa symbol space)

Union of TargetScan (family-level) and miRDB (individual miRNA-level) targets.
mmu gene symbols are converted to hsa orthologs so Jaccard is computed in the
same (hsa) gene symbol space for both species.

```{r build-target-sets}
get_targets_hsa <- function(mirna) {
  fam <- family_hsa %>% filter(mirna_name == mirna) %>% pull(mir_family)

  ts_genes <- if (length(fam) > 0) {
    ts_hsa %>% filter(mir_family %in% fam) %>% pull(gene_symbol)
  } else character(0)

  db_genes <- mirdb_hsa %>% filter(mirna_name == mirna) %>% pull(gene_symbol)

  toupper(unique(c(ts_genes, db_genes)))
}

# mmu target genes are converted to hsa ortholog symbols via ortho_vec.
# Genes without a known human ortholog are silently excluded, so both sets
# live in hsa gene symbol space — enabling direct Jaccard comparison.
get_targets_mmu <- function(mirna) {
  fam <- family_mmu %>% filter(mirna_name == mirna) %>% pull(mir_family)

  ts_genes <- if (length(fam) > 0) {
    ts_mmu %>% filter(mir_family %in% fam) %>% pull(gene_symbol)
  } else character(0)

  db_genes <- mirdb_mmu %>% filter(mirna_name == mirna) %>% pull(gene_symbol)

  mmu_syms <- toupper(unique(c(ts_genes, db_genes)))
  # Map to hsa ortholog symbols; drop unmapped entries (NA)
  hsa_syms <- ortho_vec[mmu_syms]
  unique(hsa_syms[!is.na(hsa_syms)])
}

jaccard <- function(a, b) {
  if (length(a) == 0 && length(b) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  length(intersect(a, b)) / length(union(a, b))
}

# Pre-compute target sets for unique miRNAs (avoid redundant I/O)
unique_hsa <- unique(pairs$hsa_miRNA)
unique_mmu <- unique(pairs$mmu_miRNA)

cat("Computing target sets for", length(unique_hsa), "hsa and",
    length(unique_mmu), "mmu miRNAs...\n")

hsa_targets <- setNames(lapply(unique_hsa, get_targets_hsa), unique_hsa)
mmu_targets <- setNames(lapply(unique_mmu, get_targets_mmu), unique_mmu)

# Target set size summary
ts_sizes <- bind_rows(
  tibble(species = "hsa",
         mirna   = names(hsa_targets),
         n_targets = lengths(hsa_targets)),
  tibble(species = "mmu",
         mirna   = names(mmu_targets),
         n_targets = lengths(mmu_targets))
)
cat("\nTarget set sizes:\n")
print(ts_sizes)
```

# 9. Compute Jaccard index per pair

```{r compute-jaccard}
# Alias the external lists to avoid name collision with mutate column assignments
.hsa <- hsa_targets
.mmu <- mmu_targets

jaccard_res <- pairs %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    n_hsa         = length(.hsa[[hsa_miRNA]]),
    n_mmu         = length(.mmu[[mmu_miRNA]]),
    n_intersect   = length(intersect(.hsa[[hsa_miRNA]], .mmu[[mmu_miRNA]])),
    n_union       = length(union(.hsa[[hsa_miRNA]], .mmu[[mmu_miRNA]])),
    jaccard_index = jaccard(.hsa[[hsa_miRNA]], .mmu[[mmu_miRNA]])
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(desc(jaccard_index))

cat("Jaccard index results:\n")
print(as_tibble(jaccard_res), n = Inf)

write.csv(jaccard_res,
          file.path(dir_out, "jaccard_hsa_mmu_target_overlap.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE, quote = TRUE)
cat("Saved: jaccard_hsa_mmu_target_overlap.csv\n")
```

# 10. Visualization

## 10a. Jaccard index barplot (horizontal, miRNAs on y-axis)

Pairs are ordered by Jaccard index (ascending → highest at top after coord_flip).
Significant pairs in the GSE155096 C vs T comparison (script 02) are marked:
`*` p < 0.05, `**` FDR < 0.05. Significant y-axis labels are shown in bold.

```{r plot-jaccard-bar, fig.height=6, fig.width=8}
MIRNA_CLUSTER_COLORS <- c(
  "1" = "#B3E2CD", "2" = "#FDCDAC", "3" = "#CBD5E8",
  "4" = "#F4CAE4", "5" = "#FFF2AE"
)

# Load C vs T significance from script 02 output
cvst_sig <- read.csv(file.path(dir_02, "CvsT_stats.csv"),
                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::select(mmu_miRNA, hsa_miRNA, sig, p_value, p_adj)

# Join significance to Jaccard results and build plot data
plot_jac <- jaccard_res %>%
  left_join(cvst_sig, by = c("mmu_miRNA", "hsa_miRNA")) %>%
  mutate(
    sig        = replace_na(sig, "n.s."),
    sig_mark   = case_when(
      sig == "FDR < 0.05" ~ "**",
      sig == "p < 0.05"   ~ "*",
      TRUE                ~ ""
    ),
    # Label: "mmu / hsa  **"  (marker appended with space)
    pair_label = paste0(
      sub("^mmu-", "", mmu_miRNA), " / ", sub("^hsa-", "", hsa_miRNA),
      ifelse(sig_mark != "", paste0("  ", sig_mark), "")
    ),
    miRNA_cluster = factor(as.character(miRNA_cluster), levels = 1:5),
    is_sig = sig != "n.s."
  ) %>%
  # Ascending Jaccard order → highest bar at top after coord_flip
  arrange(jaccard_index) %>%
  mutate(pair_label = factor(pair_label, levels = unique(pair_label)))

# Build axis label color vector (bold face for significant pairs)
label_face  <- ifelse(plot_jac$is_sig, "bold", "plain")
label_color <- ifelse(plot_jac$is_sig, "black", "grey40")

jac_max <- max(plot_jac$jaccard_index, na.rm = TRUE)

p_bar <- ggplot(plot_jac,
                aes(y = pair_label, x = jaccard_index, fill = miRNA_cluster)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(jaccard_index, 3)),
            hjust = -0.15, size = 3, color = "grey20") +
  scale_fill_manual(name   = "Mouse\ncluster",
                    values = MIRNA_CLUSTER_COLORS) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, jac_max * 1.18),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  scale_y_discrete() +
  labs(
    title    = "Jaccard index of target mRNAs: hsa vs mmu homologous miRNA pairs",
    subtitle = paste0("Targets = union of TargetScan v8.0 and miRDB v6.0 (no score filter)\n",
                      "* p < 0.05,  ** FDR < 0.05  (GSE155096 C vs T)"),
    y        = NULL,
    x        = "Jaccard index"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(color = "grey40", hjust = 0.5, size = 9),
    axis.text.y        = element_text(face  = label_face,
                                      color = label_color,
                                      size  = 9),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank()
  )

print(p_bar)

n_pairs <- nrow(plot_jac)
bar_h   <- max(4, n_pairs * 0.38 + 1.5)

ggsave(file.path(dir_out, "jaccard_barplot.svg"), p_bar, width = 8, height = bar_h)
ggsave(file.path(dir_out, "jaccard_barplot.png"), p_bar, width = 8, height = bar_h,
       dpi = 300)
cat("Saved: jaccard_barplot.svg / .png\n")
```

## 10b. Target set size vs Jaccard index (bubble plot)

```{r plot-bubble, fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
plot_bub <- jaccard_res %>%
  mutate(
    pair_label    = paste0(sub("^mmu-", "", mmu_miRNA), " / ",
                           sub("^hsa-", "", hsa_miRNA)),
    miRNA_cluster = factor(as.character(miRNA_cluster), levels = 1:5)
  )

p_bub <- ggplot(plot_bub,
                aes(x = n_hsa, y = n_mmu,
                    color = miRNA_cluster, size = jaccard_index)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = pair_label), size = 3,
                  max.overlaps = Inf, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(name   = "Mouse\ncluster",
                     values = MIRNA_CLUSTER_COLORS) +
  scale_size_continuous(name   = "Jaccard\nindex",
                        range  = c(3, 12),
                        breaks = c(0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Target set size vs Jaccard index",
    subtitle = "Dot size = Jaccard index; axes = number of predicted targets",
    x        = "# hsa targets (TargetScan + miRDB union)",
    y        = "# mmu targets (TargetScan + miRDB union)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey40", hjust = 0.5, size = 9)
  )

print(p_bub)

ggsave(file.path(dir_out, "jaccard_bubble.svg"), p_bub, width = 7, height = 5)
ggsave(file.path(dir_out, "jaccard_bubble.png"), p_bub, width = 7, height = 5,
       dpi = 300)
cat("Saved: jaccard_bubble.svg / .png\n")
```

## 10c. Target overlap composition barplot

Stacked bar showing the number of targets in each component
(hsa-only, shared, mmu-only) per pair. Both columns are in hsa gene symbol space.

```{r plot-overlap-stack, fig.height=5, fig.width=9}
overlap_long <- jaccard_res %>%
  mutate(
    pair_label    = paste0(sub("^mmu-", "", mmu_miRNA), " / ",
                           sub("^hsa-", "", hsa_miRNA)),
    pair_label    = factor(pair_label,
                           levels = pair_label[order(jaccard_index)]),
    n_hsa_only    = n_hsa - n_intersect,
    n_mmu_only    = n_mmu - n_intersect
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(pair_label, n_hsa_only, n_intersect, n_mmu_only) %>%
  pivot_longer(-pair_label,
               names_to  = "component",
               values_to = "count") %>%
  mutate(component = factor(component,
                             levels  = c("n_hsa_only", "n_intersect", "n_mmu_only"),
                             labels  = c("hsa only", "shared", "mmu only")))

p_stack <- ggplot(overlap_long,
                  aes(x = pair_label, y = count, fill = component)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75, color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name   = "Target\ncategory",
    values = c("hsa only" = "#4393c3",
               "shared"   = "#74c476",
               "mmu only" = "#d6604d")
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Target mRNA overlap: hsa-only / shared / mmu-only",
    subtitle = "Ordered by Jaccard index (ascending)",
    x        = "miRNA pair (mmu / hsa)",
    y        = "# target genes"
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey40", hjust = 0.5, size = 9),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank()
  )

print(p_stack)

ggsave(file.path(dir_out, "target_overlap_stacked.svg"), p_stack,
       width = 9, height = 5)
ggsave(file.path(dir_out, "target_overlap_stacked.png"), p_stack,
       width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 300)
cat("Saved: target_overlap_stacked.svg / .png\n")
```

# 11. Source breakdown per miRNA

How many targets came from TargetScan vs miRDB for each miRNA.
Note: mmu counts reflect the number of ortholog-mapped hsa symbols (after filtering unmapped genes).

```{r source-breakdown}
breakdown_hsa <- tibble(mirna = unique_hsa) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    fam       = list(family_hsa %>% filter(mirna_name == mirna) %>% pull(mir_family)),
    n_ts      = nrow(ts_hsa %>% filter(mir_family %in% fam)),
    n_db      = nrow(mirdb_hsa %>% filter(mirna_name == mirna)),
    n_ts_only = length(setdiff(
      toupper(ts_hsa %>% filter(mir_family %in% fam) %>% pull(gene_symbol)),
      toupper(mirdb_hsa %>% filter(mirna_name == mirna) %>% pull(gene_symbol))
    )),
    n_db_only = length(setdiff(
      toupper(mirdb_hsa %>% filter(mirna_name == mirna) %>% pull(gene_symbol)),
      toupper(ts_hsa %>% filter(mir_family %in% fam) %>% pull(gene_symbol))
    )),
    n_both    = length(intersect(
      toupper(ts_hsa %>% filter(mir_family %in% fam) %>% pull(gene_symbol)),
      toupper(mirdb_hsa %>% filter(mirna_name == mirna) %>% pull(gene_symbol))
    )),
    n_union   = length(hsa_targets[[mirna]])
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-fam) %>%
  mutate(species = "hsa")

breakdown_mmu <- tibble(mirna = unique_mmu) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    fam       = list(family_mmu %>% filter(mirna_name == mirna) %>% pull(mir_family)),
    n_ts      = nrow(ts_mmu %>% filter(mir_family %in% fam)),
    n_db      = nrow(mirdb_mmu %>% filter(mirna_name == mirna)),
    n_ts_only = length(setdiff(
      toupper(ts_mmu %>% filter(mir_family %in% fam) %>% pull(gene_symbol)),
      toupper(mirdb_mmu %>% filter(mirna_name == mirna) %>% pull(gene_symbol))
    )),
    n_db_only = length(setdiff(
      toupper(mirdb_mmu %>% filter(mirna_name == mirna) %>% pull(gene_symbol)),
      toupper(ts_mmu %>% filter(mir_family %in% fam) %>% pull(gene_symbol))
    )),
    n_both    = length(intersect(
      toupper(ts_mmu %>% filter(mir_family %in% fam) %>% pull(gene_symbol)),
      toupper(mirdb_mmu %>% filter(mirna_name == mirna) %>% pull(gene_symbol))
    )),
    n_union   = length(mmu_targets[[mirna]])
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-fam) %>%
  mutate(species = "mmu")

breakdown <- bind_rows(breakdown_hsa, breakdown_mmu) %>%
  dplyr::select(species, mirna, n_ts, n_db, n_ts_only, n_db_only, n_both, n_union)

cat("Target source breakdown:\n")
print(as_tibble(breakdown), n = Inf)

write.csv(breakdown,
          file.path(dir_out, "target_source_breakdown.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE, quote = TRUE)
cat("Saved: target_source_breakdown.csv\n")
```

# 12. Save shared target gene lists per pair

```{r save-shared-genes}
shared_genes_all <- jaccard_res %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    shared_genes = paste(
      sort(intersect(.hsa[[hsa_miRNA]], .mmu[[mmu_miRNA]])),
      collapse = ";"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(mmu_miRNA, hsa_miRNA, miR_family, miRNA_cluster,
                jaccard_index, n_intersect, shared_genes)

write.csv(shared_genes_all,
          file.path(dir_out, "shared_target_genes_per_pair.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE, quote = TRUE)
cat("Saved: shared_target_genes_per_pair.csv\n")
cat("\nShared gene counts:\n")
print(shared_genes_all %>% dplyr::select(-shared_genes), n = Inf)
```
